messages:
maya: Quick help — running into a weird combo: Python SDK streaming responses get stuck behind a proxy in my CI container. non-stream calls are fine, streaming waits ~30s then yields a chunk. using poetry-managed venv and httpx under the hood. anyone seen this?

alex: uh, seen similar with httpx/trust_env and proxies. if httpx picks up system proxy it can block streaming sockets. are you setting HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY? :thinking:

maya: yep we have HTTPS_PROXY set for egress in CI. local dev (no proxy) works fine.

alex: two quick tries: 1) set `trust_env=False` on the httpx client so it ignores env proxies; 2) explicitly pass `proxies=None` or configure an AsyncClient with `limits=...` so connections don't get pooled weirdly. example: ```python
import os
import httpx
from redwood import AsyncClient

httpx_client = httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False)
client = AsyncClient(httpx_client=httpx_client, api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

maya: nice, will try. FYI our SDK init looks like `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., stream=True)` so had to poke into httpx.

tj: also check retries — if your retry middleware retries on stream errors it may buffer and re-open connections. ensure streaming endpoints are excluded from aggressive retry policies. we had a bug where `max_retries=3` caused delayed first-chunk when upstream proxy injected a 502 then healed.

maya: good call, we do have a global retry decorator for requests. can you clarify how to exclude streams? small snippet would help.

tj: usually two ways: a) detect `stream=True` and bypass retry logic, or b) use streaming-aware retries that don't re-send body. pseudo: ```python
if kwargs.get("stream"):
    return send_once(request)
else:
    return retry(send_once)
```

alex: aside: if you're running under poetry's virtualenv and using keyring for creds, poetry's venv can differ from your user's keyring backend. simple workaround: export REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI env instead of relying on keyring. poetry run doesn't automatically surface system keyring sometimes.

maya: that explains why sometimes auth fails silently and we fall back to anonymous then weird errors. switching to explicit env var fixed local repro.

devex-bot: Tip: see docs/devex/python#auth for recommended CI patterns and proxy notes (internal link). :books: 

maya: ok after setting `trust_env=False` and removing retry on stream paths the streaming is smooth in CI. leaving notes in the PR. thanks! :thumbsup:

alex: awesome — can you add a tiny integration test that runs behind a local proxy (mitmproxy) to catch regressions? quick pytest with httpx mocking helped us.

maya: yep will add a test and flag the PR for review.

tj: and maybe add a short devex note about poetry/keyring quirk so others avoid env surprises.

maya: adding that to PR description now.
